funds.name: 모태펀드(보건복지부) 2026년 2차 정시 출자사업 — 프리미어파트너스 GP 선정

size.raw: 모태펀드 출자 400억원 → 최소 2,000억원 규모 펀드 결성 목표

strategy.thesis: KVIC operates Korea's national Fund of Funds (모태펀드), a 30-year (2005-2035) policy vehicle capitalized by 12 government ministries; its Ministry of Health & Welfare-backed healthcare account (보건계정) supplies anchor LP capital to private VC funds that back biotech, digital health and medical-device startups, including a dedicated ₩150bn Phase-3 clinical-stage fund launched in 2026.

summary.en: KVIC is the state-run manager of South Korea's Fund of Funds; its Ministry of Health & Welfare healthcare account is a major LP behind the country's biotech/health VC ecosystem, most recently anchoring a KRW 150bn Phase-3 clinical-trial-stage fund.
summary.local: 한국벤처투자(KVIC)는 한국모태펀드를 운용하는 국책기관으로, 보건복지부가 출자하는 보건계정을 통해 바이오·헬스케어 벤처펀드에 앵커 LP로 출자한다.

sources.supports: FoF structure, 2005 establishment, 12-ministry LP structure, healthcare account existence, ₩8.9tn AUM
sources.quote: Established in 2005 under the Special Measures Act for Venture Business Development, the Korea Fund of Funds operates as a Fund of Funds structure... Twelve government ministries and agencies (including the Ministry of Health and Welfare)... Size: ₩8.9 trillion (as of December 2023)

verification_notes: The ₩8.9tn AUM figure is for the entire Fund of Funds across ~17 sector accounts, not bio-specific; the healthcare/MOHW account size alone was not separately disclosed in sources reviewed.

strategy.thesis: Ministry of Health & Welfare flagship policy fund series (jointly capitalized with Korea Development Bank and IBK) that anchors private VC funds dedicated to biopharma and vaccine company financing, part of MOHW's plan to grow this into a roughly KRW 1 trillion 'K-Bio Mega Fund'.

summary.en: K-Bio & Vaccine Fund is South Korea's Ministry of Health & Welfare-led policy fund series (1st-7th funds since 2023), co-capitalized with KDB/IBK, that seeds private-sector VC funds investing in biopharma and vaccine developers.
summary.local: K-바이오·백신 펀드는 보건복지부가 산업은행·기업은행과 공동 출자해 2023년부터 조성 중인 정책펀드 시리즈로, 민간 VC를 통해 바이오·백신 기업에 투자한다.

strategy.thesis: State-backed fund-of-funds operator (jointly established by KDB, IBK and the Korea Youth Entrepreneurship Foundation) whose K-Growth Fund lines direct a core share of capital to AI, bio-health and energy value chains, anchoring private VC/PE funds that invest in Korean healthcare and biotech companies.

summary.en: K-Growth is a Korean policy fund-of-funds manager, successor to the 성장사다리펀드 (Growth Ladder Fund), that channels government/policy-bank capital into VC and PE funds targeting AI, bio-health and energy as core sectors.
summary.local: 한국성장금융(K-Growth)은 성장사다리펀드를 계승한 정책 모태펀드 운용사로, AI·바이오헬스·에너지를 핵심 투자 분야로 삼아 벤처·PE 펀드에 출자한다.

sources.title: 한국성장금융투자운용
sources.supports: Founding year 2016, KDB/IBK/은행권청년창업재단 origin
sources.quote: 2013년 대한민국 중소·벤처기업 성장을 지원하기 위하여 한국산업은행, 중소기업은행, 은행권청년창업재단이 공동으로 운용하던 성장사다리펀드 등을 효율적으로 운용하기 위하여 2016년 설립된 주식회사입니다.

sources.title: 성장금융, '증권금융 K-Growth 펀드' GP 9곳 확정

sources.quote: K-Growth 펀드의 주목적 투자 대상이 AI·바이오헬스·에너지 등 3대 핵심 산업 밸류체인에 집중됩니다.

verification_notes: General fund-of-funds operator, not bio-exclusive; healthcare is one of three named core sectors for its current K-Growth Fund line. Facts based on Wikipedia + trade press, not a direct fetch of kgrowth.or.kr.

perks: investment matchmaking (Invest Fair, K-BIC STAR DAY)

strategy.thesis: KHIDI is the Ministry of Health & Welfare's implementing agency for the bio-health industry; it runs investment-attraction and startup-incubation programs (Biohealth Innovation Start-up Center, K-BIC STAR DAY investor days, Professional Investment Institution Linkage program) that connect Korean biotech/medtech/digital-health startups with VCs.

track_record.portfolio_count: 98 companies (2021-2024 cohort of the Professional Investment Institution Linkage program)

summary.en: KHIDI is South Korea's national health-industry promotion agency (under MOHW, HQ in Cheongju); it runs investor-matchmaking and startup support programs — since 2021 its Professional Investment Institution Linkage program has helped 98 companies raise roughly KRW 105.9bn.
summary.local: 한국보건산업진흥원(KHIDI)은 보건복지부 산하 보건산업 진흥기관으로, 전문투자기관 연계형 투자유치 지원사업 등을 통해 바이오헬스 스타트업의 투자 유치를 지원한다.

sources.title: KHIDI 대표사이트
sources.supports: Existence, official site, founded Feb 1999, HQ Cheongju
sources.quote: KHIDI is a government institution established in February 1999

sources.title: 2025년 전문 투자기관 연계형 투자유치 지원사업 참여 기업 모집
sources.supports: 98 companies, ~₩105.9bn raised via Investment Institution Linkage program since 2021
sources.quote: From 2021 onwards, KHIDI has operated a 'Professional Investment Institution Linkage Investment Attraction Support Program,' which has supported a total of 98 promising startup companies over four years and achieved investment attraction results of approximately 105.9 billion won.

verification_notes: Founded-year and HQ-city facts came from an aggregated search summary rather than a directly fetched primary page; treat as medium confidence pending direct verification.

strategy.thesis: KDDF is Korea's multi-ministerial (범부처) national new-drug development program, providing non-dilutive R&D funding and pipeline-investment support across the full drug-development cycle (target discovery through clinical trials) to strengthen the domestic pharma/biotech industry and drug sovereignty.

track_record.portfolio_count: 128 new-drug development projects planned for support in 2025

summary.en: KDDF (Korea Drug Development Fund) is a multi-ministry government program that funds Korean new-drug development end-to-end, from candidate discovery through clinical trials, selecting roughly 128 projects for 2025 support.
summary.local: 국가신약개발사업단(KDDF)은 범부처 국가 R&D 사업으로 신약개발 전주기를 지원하며, 2025년 128건의 신규 과제 지원을 목표로 한다.

sources.title: 선택과 집중, 창조와 혁신으로 국가 제약-바이오 산업을 견인
sources.supports: Mission, multi-ministerial full-cycle drug development program
sources.quote: 이 사업은 국내 제약·바이오 산업의 글로벌 경쟁력 강화와 국민건강의 필수조건인 의약주권 확보를 위해 신약개발 전주기 단계를 지원하는 범부처 국가 R&D 사업입니다.

sources.title: KDDF, 내년 신약개발 128건 지원 목표…임상 예산 30% 늘린다
sources.supports: 128 projects planned for 2025, clinical trial budget +30%

verification_notes: Founding year not confirmed in sources reviewed (KDDF traces back to a 2011-era 범부처신약개발사업단 predecessor later reorganized as a foundation); omitted rather than guessed. A total 10-year government R&D budget figure (~₩1.47tn) appeared only in aggregated search summary without a confirmed verbatim source, so omitted.

strategy.thesis: KMDF is a four-ministry (Science & ICT, Trade/Industry/Energy, Health & Welfare, Food & Drug Safety) national R&D and investment-attraction program for medical devices, funding development from R&D through clinical trials and helping portfolio companies raise follow-on private investment.

summary.en: KMDF is South Korea's inter-ministerial medical-device R&D funding program (2020-2032, roughly KRW 2tn combined across two phases) that also runs investment-attraction and commercialization support for device startups.
summary.local: 범부처전주기의료기기연구개발사업단(KMDF)은 4개 부처가 공동 운영하는 의료기기 R&D 지원사업으로, 투자유치 및 사업화 지원도 병행한다.

strategy.thesis: A Ministry of Health & Welfare-affiliated public institution operating Korea's Daegu-Gyeongbuk Advanced Medical Complex; alongside R&D infrastructure (New Drug Development Support Center, preclinical/GMP centers) it deploys a KRW 50bn Medi-City industry development fund to support pharma/medtech company growth.

summary.en: K-Medi hub is a MOHW-affiliated public foundation running Korea's Daegu-Gyeongbuk advanced medical complex, combining new-drug/medical-device R&D infrastructure with a KRW 50bn Medi-City fund for industry support.
summary.local: 대구경북첨단의료산업진흥재단(K-Medi hub)은 보건복지부 산하 공공기관으로, 대구경북첨단의료복합단지의 R&D 인프라와 500억원 규모 메디시티기금을 통해 제약·의료기기 기업을 지원한다.

strategy.thesis: A Ministry of Health & Welfare-affiliated public foundation in the Osong Bio Health Complex that funds and provides infrastructure for industry-academia-hospital new-drug development collaboration, plus technology-transfer/investment-matchmaking support for biopharma startups.

summary.en: KBIOHealth is a MOHW-affiliated public foundation based in Osong that supports Korean biopharma R&D and industry-academia-hospital drug-development collaboration, including technology-transfer and investment-recruitment services for startups.
summary.local: 오송첨단의료산업진흥재단(KBIOHealth)은 보건복지부 산하 공공기관으로 오송첨단의료복합단지에서 산학연병 신약개발 협력과 기술이전·투자유치를 지원한다.

strategy.thesis: A Korea Development Bank (KDB)-led sovereign growth fund targeting AI, bio-health, batteries/semiconductors and energy as core strategic industries; its bio-health track provides direct investment and loans to late-stage (global Phase 3) drug developers to fund commercialization of new medicines.

summary.en: National Growth Fund is a large KDB-led state development fund (~KRW 7.45tn target) backing AI, bio-health and energy; its bio-health arm directly finances Korean drug developers in global Phase 3 trials en route to commercialization.
summary.local: 국민성장펀드는 산업은행이 주도하는 대규모 국책성장펀드(조성목표 약 7.45조원)로, AI·바이오헬스·에너지 등을 핵심 산업으로 삼으며 글로벌 임상3상 단계 신약 개발기업에 직접투자·대출을 지원한다.

sources.title: 산업은행, 7.5조 규모 '국민성장펀드' 모펀드 운용사 뽑는다
sources.supports: Fund size ~KRW 7.45-7.5tn, KDB-led

sources.title: 국민성장펀드, 소버린 AI부터 배터리·바이오까지…올해 8.4조 풀었다
sources.supports: Bio-health direct investment/loans to global Phase-3 drug developers
sources.quote: 차세대 바이오 백신설비 구축 및 R&D 지원사업으로 상업화를 앞둔 마지막 관문인 글로벌 임상3상 기업 등에 대한 직접투자와 대출지원으로 유망신약의 개발과 상용화를 전폭 지원합니다.

verification_notes: A very new, broad national growth fund (AI/bio/energy/semiconductors) — bio-health is one of several core tracks, not the sole focus; included because it explicitly and verifiably finances late-stage biopharma commercialization. Website listed is KDB's general site; no dedicated fund microsite was found.
